[/b][/i][/size][center][u][b][size=3]T[i]ested with the latest game update, the latest SMAPI update and the latest Content Patcher update.[/i][/size][/b][/u][/center]
[center][size=3]I needed a break from the color wheel, so may I present to you, 96 new hairstyles, a mix of original textures and edited game assets, for [u][b]Content Patcher[/b][/u] (available at character creation, and later at the Wizard's cellar after reaching 4 hearts with him).

While I want to add more styles, I need time to practice and improve my pixelwork, so it'll probably take months between updates.

I do hope you'll enjoy what's available![/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VrwxCwa.png[/img]

[size=3]Also available an optional file in a lighter grey making it easier to have pastel/neon colors ingame![/size]
